topics.description: The FBI's investigation into the 2020 election in Georgia is gaining momentum, with 260 staffers assigned to the case. This comes as concerns about election integrity continue to grow.
topics.reason: The investigation is trending due to its potential impact on future elections.

topics.description: A Medicaid fraud crackdown in Minnesota is causing concern among patients and providers. The crackdown aims to prevent fraudulent activity in the healthcare system.
topics.reason: The crackdown is trending due to its potential impact on access to healthcare.
